name: tejas-client
description: Hackathon project developed for AI 4 Andhra Police Hackathon 2025. This application addresses Use-Case 1: AI-enabled analysis of citizen petitions received at PS/SP/CO levels. It intelligently extracts claims from complaints, maps them to relevant evidence types, and supports officers in informed decision-making. The system is designed with scalability, clarity, and practical impact in mind. Future enhancements aim to integrate secure GenAI workflows, real-time feedback mechanisms, and deployment-ready infrastructure — all geared toward enabling efficient policing and building citizen trust.
author: Vijaykumar Nanikeri
